description: Post to Slack, deliberately (chat.postMessage). Fire-and-forget pings on the op stream are already covered by the Slack webhook notifier example in docs/notifiers.md -- this preset is for the case that example cannot cover: a call-it-on-purpose post whose response you need back (#2032).

slack_publish.description: Post a message to a Slack channel or thread (chat.postMessage). Returns the posted message's own ts, which a later thread reply or edit needs.
